description: 構成因子(OS/ブラウザ/解像度/機種など)と水準、網羅方針(single=シングルカバレッジ / pairwise=ペア / full=フル)、除外する組合せとその理由から、決定的に構成一覧を生成し、水準実体化率・ペア実体化率(生成した構成表に対する構造値。テストの達成度ではない)と、actualRows(利用者が実際にテストした構成表)を渡した場合のみ算出する実被覆率・除外理由未記入をMarkdownで返す。各構成は CFG: プレフィックスの網羅対象IDとして generate_test_cases の configMatrix へそのまま渡せる。

actualRows.description: Configurations actually planned/executed by the user. Level/pair coverage ratios are computed ONLY against these rows; without them the tool reports realization ratios only.

completedTools.description: Already executed tools; entries without evidence are treated as not executed

evidence.description: Evidence of execution: an output file path (e.g. docs/test-cases.md) or an output heading line starting with '#'

outputExcerpt.description: Excerpt of the declared tool's actual output text. Must contain that tool's own H1 heading line; otherwise the declaration is reported as evidence-unverified and still counted as not executed

toolName.description: Name of an already executed tool in this workflow

coveragePolicy.description: Coverage policy: single (each level once), pairwise (all level pairs), full (full product); default single

excludedCombinations.description: Combinations that are excluded from the generated matrix

reason.description: Why this combination is excluded; leaving it empty is flagged as CMC-06[high]

factors.description: Configuration factors (OS, browser, resolution, device, etc.)

id.description: Factor id, unique within the matrix, e.g. F1

levels.description: Levels of this factor; at least 1

name.description: Factor name, e.g. OS / Browser / Resolution

matrixId.description: Matrix id used to build coverage target ids (default MAIN)

maxSearchNodes.description: Node budget per reachability search / greedy completion (default 5000)

testBasisDocuments.description: Test basis documents used to verify that declared labels (factor names, level values, state names, etc.), quoted wordings and referenced ids really exist in the test basis. Pass the full text: passing only excerpts makes existing wordings be reported as ungrounded. When omitted, the grounding check is reported as not inspectable instead of passing silently.

content.description: Full text of the document (any format; caller converts binaries to text)

name.description: Document name or file name of the test basis document

name: design_config_matrix
title: Design Config Matrix
